chapterPlayback.description: Mr Sark is throwing down the gauntlet. Drop what you're doing, because Sarkathlon 3 is officially go. Find out all the details in this video and then fire up 'Halo 3' and get in the game. Go to g4tv.com/Sark3 for the official rules.

chapterPlayback.description: Gamertag is always up for a challenge, big or small. In this Gamertag Film, he tries to tackle Mr Sark's 'Halo 3' obstacle course by entering 'Sarkathlon 3'. It doesn't go so hot...or does it?

chapterPlayback.description: Adam Sessler and Mr Sark talk about 'Halo 3' technique as they reveal the 1st and 2nd place winners of 'Sarkathlon 3'. Check out the winning runs by Tylyr1 and DJMaluu and find out how they submitted the best, mindblowing times!
chapterPlayback.title: Sarkathlon 3 'Halo 3' Winner Wrap-Up

chapterPlayback.description: Mr Sark travels to Cryptic to preview 'Champions Online' the new MMO. Bill Roper, Jack Emert and John Needham from Cryptic talk about in-game powers and abilities, character creation and leveling.

chapterPlayback.description: Mr Sark kicks off another one of his infamous challenges. Find out about the latest Mr Sark Challenge "The Battlefield 1943 Sniper Showdown" happening on the Xbox 360 on August 24th and the PlayStation 3 on August 25th.

chapterPlayback.description: Battlefield 1943
chapterPlayback.title: Mr. Sark's Battlefield 1943 Sniper Showdown Winners

chapterPlayback.description: Our resident Halo expert Mr Sark travels to Bungie to talk to Lars Bakken about the Halo 3: ODST Multiplayer Maps Heretic, Citadel and Longshore. Then, Mr Sark and Adam discuss "The Road to Recon" campaign challenge.
chapterPlayback.title: Mr Sark: Halo 3: ODST Multiplayer Maps Preview

chapterPlayback.description: Mr Sark rolls up in the G4 Scion Moble Studio to find out what diehard Blizzard fans think of BlizzCon 2009. Spoiler alert: they all think it's pretty "awesome."
chapterPlayback.title: BlizzCon 2009: Fan Reactions with Mr Sark

chapterPlayback.description: Find out the details for the fourth Halo 3 Sarkathlon! Use your skills to compete for a super rare Flaming Armor from Bungie!

chapterPlayback.description: Adam Sessler interviews Mr Sark about Sarkathlon 4, the latest challenge taking place in Halo 3. If you want some behind-the-scenes information and some hints on how to win that coveted Flaming Armor, you need to watch this video.
chapterPlayback.title: Halo 3 Sarkathlon 4 Tips Interview

chapterPlayback.description: Mr Sark talks to Adam Sessler about 'Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2' and the game's multiplayer mode. Hear Mr Sark's thoughts on the maps, unlockables and more in 'Modern Warfare 2' multiplayer.
chapterPlayback.title: Modern Warfare 2 Multiplayer Discussion with Mr Sark

chapterPlayback.description: Mr Sark joins us live on the set to announce and discuss the winner 'Sarkathlon 4'. See who completed the 'Halo 3: ODST' obstacle course the fastest and won the Bungie Flaming Armor.
chapterPlayback.title: Sarkathlon 4 Wrap-Up

chapterPlayback.description: Our resident expert Mr Sark lists his top five shooter video game franchises of all time including 'Team Fortress', 'Battlefield', 'Ghost Recon', 'Call of Duty' and 'Halo'.
